open_gaps: backend-postgres-persistence: backend-go convention requires Postgres via pgx with numbered SQL migrations under migrations/; the repo's only MovieRepository implementation is in-memory (backend/internal/adapters/memory), with no database adapter or migrations at all

frontend-atomic-design: frontend-react convention wants src/components/{atoms,molecules,organisms,templates}; the repo only has components/ui (shadcn) and components/molecules, with domain-aware components (CreateMovieDialog, MovieActions, RemoveMovieAction, UpdateMovieAction) living directly under pages/movies instead of components/organisms
frontend-storybook: frontend-react convention requires a story for every atom and molecule; the repo has no Storybook setup and no *.stories.tsx files at all
